name: The Last Ride
summary: The tree has burned. Mend what you like in Wickermoor, then go down to the old station when the fog is thick enough.

stages.journal: The Crooked Tree burned and the valley is changed. Wickermoor is quiet and busy at once: closing talks to have, graves to see, a fair on the Round.
objectives: Go down to the old station when ready
stages.hint: Walk the village and talk to anyone who mattered. The old station is south of the bridge, whenever we are ready.

stages.journal: The Ghostlight Express came out of the fog for us. The Vagrant holds the door and the ticket reads Destination: Unknown.
stages.hint: Choose where the train takes us, or step down for one more goodbye.
